understand.title: Understand
understand.purpose: Clarify what is being brought, where it belongs and why it matters before detailed analysis begins.
information: New idea, existing prototype, new data, enhancement or operational issue.
The problem, opportunity or operational risk being addressed.
The existing value pool or portfolio area to which the demand belongs.
The capability, process or decision that will be improved.
Who owns the outcome and who will use or benefit from it.
The business measure expected to improve.

discover.title: Discover
discover.purpose: Validate value, understand the current state and recommend the best path before committing to delivery.
information: Existing process, solution, prototype, reports and workarounds.
Observed benefits, pain points, demand, adoption or measurable impact.
Reusable Data Products, dashboards, APIs, models or enterprise capabilities.
Available data, missing data, quality, ownership and access constraints.
Users, geographies, transaction volumes, integrations and criticality.
Reuse, enhance, industrialize, build, stop or route to support.

design.title: Design
design.purpose: Translate the recommendation into an enterprise-ready solution, operating model and delivery blueprint.
information: What is included, excluded and reused.
Integration, data, platform, identity, security and non-functional needs.
Ownership, consumers, service level and lifecycle.
AI risk, human oversight, transparency and control requirements where applicable.
Privacy, security, data governance, records and compliance requirements.
Monitoring, incident ownership, release and operational responsibilities.
readiness: Required governance reviews are complete or planned

build.title: Build
build.purpose: Create and validate the solution incrementally while maintaining alignment to value, architecture and controls.
information: Prioritized backlog, milestones, dependencies and release scope.
Business, data, technical and governance expectations.
Functional, data quality, model, security and performance testing.
Connection between business need, requirement, delivery item and KPI.
Process, role, training and adoption changes.

launch.title: Launch
launch.purpose: Release safely, support adoption and transition the capability into a sustainable operating model.
information: Release sequence, cutover, rollback and validation.
Target users, communications, training and usage expectations.
Service Manager, product team, operations and escalation route.
Technical health, data quality, usage, model and business indicators.
Named Product Manager, business owner and technical owner.

measure.title: Measure
measure.purpose: Confirm whether the product delivers the expected outcome and decide what should happen next.
information: Actual result compared with baseline and target.
Users, frequency, retention and breadth of use.
Reliability, performance, data quality and support demand.
Savings, risk reduction, productivity, revenue or decision improvement.
User experience, unmet needs and improvement opportunities.
Scale, enhance, maintain, consolidate or retire.
